purpose: Identify precisely which F28 first-party JSON label field is absent or schema-mismatched, without retrying F28 knowledge-source intake, inventing labels, or changing source-admission standards.
source_reader_contract: Call existing checked F27 LiveEntityData.fetch once per QID; no revision rereads, endpoints, property lookups or model training. It checks HTTPS Wikidata origin, exact entity ID, raw SHA256 and lastrevid.
output_redaction: No label string, all multilingual fields, source raw JSON, model weights or private data printed. Only compact observed field types, boolean, counts, Wikidata IDs, revisions and SHA256.
stop_on_error: On non-200, bad source ID, any redirect outside pinned Wikidata source, > frozen byte cap, invalid JSON, missing entity/revision, report F29_DIAGNOSTIC_BLOCKED with generic reason and no source fallback.
acceptance: Focused source-free Linux+Windows tests and a one-shot GitHub Actions read-only metadata receipt for the exactly two original seed IDs. If either lacks en, record factual schema shape; do not change F28 or infer Wikidata globally lacks English labels.
next_after_receipt: Only if the two source schema receipts identify a demonstrable client parsing error, make one smallest source-only correction under new separately frozen source-custody plan and strong negatives. Else stop and use an independently licensed pinned source archive.
